authority: Exact supplied retail AMD64 executable; independently matched native callers, descriptors, data literals and graph targets. Assigned names are ours.

native_spawn.team_transfer: Native helper writes sentient team+8 and actor team mirror+0x1378.
native_spawn.goal: Native setgoalpos caller uses actor pointer, Vec3 pointer, optional node=null; helper has no boolean success return.
native_spawn.animation: Native caller builds each hand with (WeaponDef*, names**) returning distinct arena-owned opaque definitions. Runtime requests use already validated/loaded normal names, not guessed asset names.
native_spawn.scope: First retail test pending for temporary helper spawners, forced-visibility bypass with independent collision traces, team conversion, goals and queued hand creation.

calling_convention: Windows AMD64: RCX/RDX/R8/R9 then stack arguments. Opaque engine objects, no T5 or historical complete structure casts.
